reason: I'd try the free 14 days because it costs nothing, but I'd not pay 69 baht until I've seen it read my own K PLUS slip and my own card statement correctly. I quit the last budget app within weeks because typing everything was a chore, so I'm not confident I'll keep this going either.
objection: I don't know if it works with my bank or my card. The page only names K PLUS, Bangkok Bank and TTB for slips, and says nothing about which card statements it reads.
would_change_my_mind: A list of the banks and card issuers it reads, and a trial where my own slip or statement comes through correctly before I'm charged.
